share.line: While share viewing is on, reads the current tab’s address, title and site icon and sends them to the current squad.

token.line: When a token is detected, sends its chain and contract address to the Palside service, which reads the public name, symbol and icon on-chain. All users share one record.
token.who: Palside service; blockchain nodes receive only the contract address
token.keep: Public token details are stored on the service and deleted after 90 days without lookups; lookups are not attributed
token.no: Page content, balances, holdings, orders, wallets

chart.line: With Share with squad on, the tool, coordinates and style of new lines, text and emoji drawn with the site’s tools are sent to the squad. Teammates’ drawings render on your chart; site scripts can read the shapes but cannot identify who drew them.
chart.keep: Until the author deletes them or turns off Share with squad, within the squad’s message retention; laser pointer strokes are not stored
chart.no: Drawings made while Share with squad is off, chart pixels, page text, input content

signal.line: Sending a signal reads the target position and a small amount of nearby text, labels or link addresses so teammates can locate the same spot.
signal.keep: Removed from the page after 5 seconds; the chat record follows the squad’s message retention
signal.no: Inputs, editable areas, dropdowns, hidden content, canvases, embedded pages and Palside’s own page elements

room.line: While the panel is online and danmaku is on, the token being viewed is submitted to the service. Turning danmaku off stops submission; sent danmaku remain public.
room.who: The service sees the token, account and device session; viewer counts, danmaku and like counts are public; likers are not
room.keep: The viewed token is held in memory only and cleared 40 seconds after leaving; each token keeps its latest 10,000 danmaku; likes remain until withdrawn, the danmaku is deleted or the account is closed

shot.line: Using the screenshot shortcut or button reads the current tab’s image; it is sent to the squad only after an area is selected and confirmed.
shot.keep: Squad message retention, up to 30 days

follow.line: While following, the other person’s pages are kept in a tab group named after them; the address of their foreground page and scroll position are sent to you encrypted.
follow.keep: Not added to chat history; tab mappings last until the browser session ends
follow.no: Your own tabs, other tab groups

notify.line: Reads no pages. Shows a desktop notification when the squad has new messages.
notify.who: Chrome and the operating system; the OS may retain a copy
notify.keep: Local click records clear when the notification is closed, clicked or expires; OS notification history may persist

presence.line: Active while the side panel is open or keyboard or mouse input occurred in the last 5 minutes, otherwise Away. Only this state is reported.
presence.keep: Held in service memory only; expires 40 seconds after the last report

purpose.question: What is Palside?
purpose.answer: A side panel extension for desktop Chrome for following tokens with your squad: share viewing, page interaction (signals, danmaku) and end-to-end encrypted squad chat.

account.question: Do I need to sign up?
account.answer: No email or phone number. Your account derives from a 12-word recovery phrase generated on your device. Palside never stores it; a lost phrase cannot be recovered.

privacy.question: Can my squad see what I browse?
privacy.answer: Only while Share viewing is on, and only your current tab’s token, or its page title and link. Page content, your screen and page actions are never shared. Screenshots appear only after you send them.

permissions.question: Which browser permissions are required?
permissions.answer: None that trigger a Chrome warning at install. Share viewing requires “Read your browsing history”; page interaction is granted per site. Both can be revoked in Chrome.

encryption.question: How is chat encrypted?
encryption.answer: Messages, images and viewing status are end-to-end encrypted on members’ devices; servers relay ciphertext only. A new device decrypts only messages received after sign-in.

teams.question: How do I join a squad?
teams.answer: Through an invitation link, or by applying in Discover squads for captain approval. Each squad holds up to 30 members.

film.heroAccessible: Opening demo: one click on Share on PONS turns on Share viewing and Page interaction together; public danmaku cross the chart while the last candle keeps trading. Kai draws a rising support through two higher lows, and Leo circles the last candles, back at the old high. Holding ⌥ opens the signal wheel and sends “Look here” on the pullback’s low; a teammate answers “Look together” on the old high. Robin calls the squad, you follow him from his profile card, and Chrome opens the “Following Robin” tab group on CHUMP. Back on your own tab, the group follows Robin in the background as he navigates, opens and closes tabs. You open Robin's red packet, close the group's last tab to stop following, and turn sharing off. All demo data is fictional.

permissions.title: Browser permissions
permissions.summary: No website access is requested at install. Chrome asks for optional permissions the first time you enable the feature that needs them.
permissions.note: Chrome offers no read-only site permission, hence the wording “read and change”; Palside uses it only as listed above. Turning a feature off does not revoke its permission; revoke it in Settings › Privacy & data.

panel.title: Side panel, storage and idle state
panel.detail: Runs the side panel and local encryption; shows you as away after 5 minutes without input, reporting only active or away.

active.title: Current tab
active.detail: Captures a screenshot of the tab when you click the toolbar icon or press the screenshot shortcut.

history.title: Read your browsing history
history.detail: Share viewing and page recognition: reads only the address and title of the foreground tab; nothing is stored and page content is not read.

site.title: Read and change site data
site.detail: Page interaction (danmaku, signals); granted per site or for all sites.

notifications.title: Display notifications
notifications.detail: Alerts for new messages, mentions and replies.

tabGroups.title: View and manage your tab groups
tabGroups.detail: Asked the first time you follow someone, only to name the follow tab group. Following works without it.

data.title: Data visibility
data.note: End-to-end encryption protects content but does not hide all metadata. Only the screenshot you confirm is uploaded, without the original or cropped areas.

device.title: Your device only
device.detail: Recovery phrase, local password and wallet private key; full screenshots and their editing; drafts; the page text index for locating signals.

squad.title: Squad members
squad.detail: Chat text and images, page cards, signals, and the token or page shared through Share viewing. Links are stripped of tracking parameters; links carrying sign-in credentials send only the site name. The service stores ciphertext only.

public.title: Everyone
public.detail: Danmaku, like counts, and the poster’s nickname and avatar; public profiles of recruiting squads; addresses, amounts and transaction hashes of PALS onchain transactions.

service.title: Palside service
service.detail: Account public key, squad membership, connection times and IP; tokens whose danmaku you join, without page addresses; token contracts looked up for names and icons, without recording who asked; wallet order status; reports you confirm.

retention.title: Retention
retention.note: There are no server backups. Palside cannot retrieve copies saved by other members; onchain records are public and cannot be deleted.

messages.title: Squad messages
messages.detail: Set by the captain to 1, 7 or 30 days, or forever, forever by default; images are kept at most 30 days.

danmaku.title: Danmaku
danmaku.detail: The latest 10,000 lines per token are kept; authors can withdraw their own.

votes.title: Likes
votes.detail: Kept until taken back, the line is removed or the account is deleted.

device.title: On your device
device.detail: Drafts are kept for 7 days; signing out clears local caches and decryption keys.

thirdParties.title: Third-party services
thirdParties.services: Squad chat runs on a Matrix service operated by Palside. Alchemy and RPC nodes process the PALS transactions you sign and never receive private keys. Token names and icons are read by Palside's server from blockchain RPC nodes, IPFS gateways and Codex, then cached; these services receive only contract addresses sent by the server, never your account, pages or IP.
thirdParties.use: Palside does not sell user data or use it for advertising, creditworthiness or lending. The use of information received from Chrome APIs will adhere to the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

choices.title: Your choices and contact
choices.controls: Revoke permissions and clear local caches in Settings › Privacy & data. Deleting your account removes your profile and associations; the service keeps only the public key and deletion time. Onchain records are excluded.
choices.contact: Palside is not directed to anyone under 18. For privacy questions, contact palside@pm.me.

terms.lead: By using Palside, you agree to these terms.

service.title: The service
service.body: Palside is a desktop Chrome side-panel extension and related service providing squad chat, Share viewing, Page interaction, danmaku and the PALS wallet. It is operated by palside and can be reached at {email}. You must be at least 18 years old to use it. The handling of personal data is described in the Privacy policy.

account.title: Account and wallet
account.body: Your recovery phrase is generated on your device and controls both your account and wallet. Palside neither stores nor requests it and cannot recover it if lost; keep your own secure backup. The wallet is used only for PALS transfers, red packets and tips. Palside charges no fees and pays network fees on your behalf, up to a daily limit. Confirmed onchain transactions cannot be reversed; deleting your account neither deletes onchain records nor moves your balance.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Do not use Palside to send spam, commit scams or phishing, harass or impersonate others, or distribute illegal, sexual, violent or hateful content. You are responsible for the content you send; captains are responsible for recruiting profiles and squad management. Where a violation is confirmed on review, Palside may remove public profiles, take down recruiting, delete danmaku or ban the account. Bans last 7 days, 30 days or permanently and sign out every device. Appeals may be sent to {email}.

public.title: Public content
public.body: Danmaku, like counts and the profiles of recruiting squads are public, and recruiting profiles may be indexed by search engines. When recruiting ends, the website page is removed; search engine caches expire on their own schedules.

liability.title: Disclaimer
liability.body: The service is provided as is, without any guarantee of continuous or uninterrupted availability. Palside does not offer buying, swapping or trading services. Token names and icons come from public blockchain data and image services and do not establish a project’s authenticity; USD prices are indicative only, and no information constitutes investment advice. Palside is not affiliated with the third-party sites it displays. Messages may become unavailable after they expire or after a service failure, and servers keep no backups.

changes.title: Changes and termination
changes.body: You may delete your account at any time to stop using the service. Updated terms are published on this page with a revised date; continued use after an update constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
